frequency_manager.频段扫描的频率步进 (Hz)\n生成主要扫描点: 起始 -> 起始+步进 ->:
Frequency step for band scanning (Hz)
Generates the main scan points: start -> start+step -> start+2*step -> end

Key requirement:
The step must be <= the band width (%.1f kHz)
Otherwise the scanner will skip the whole band!

Efficient two-level scanning:
1. Hardware tuning: the radio tunes to each step point (108.0, 109.0 MHz)
   and captures FFT spectrum data within the radio bandwidth
2. FFT analysis: digital analysis using the scanner's analysis interval
   checks 108.005, 108.010... in the captured data (no retuning needed!)

Why a 1000 kHz step + 5 kHz interval works so well:
- Step = hardware tuning (slower, but only once per 1000 kHz)
- Analysis interval = digital FFT analysis (fast, every 5 kHz)
- Result = fast main hops + thorough spectrum coverage
- The radio bandwidth limits the useful interval range at each step point

Recommended steps:
- 100-1000 kHz: best for scanning wide bands together with an analysis interval
- 25-100 kHz: good for mixed scan types
- 5-25 kHz: highest precision, speed limited by hardware

Tip: a large step with a small interval works very well (the strength of FFT!)

scanner.内存中频谱分析的步长，用于频谱搜索 (Hz)\n基于已采集的频谱数据分析，不占用:
Step of the in-memory spectrum analysis used for spectrum search (Hz)
Works on the already captured spectrum data and does not use the hardware tuner
With the Frequency Manager: step = hardware tuning hop, analysis interval = frequency analysis
Common values: 5000 Hz (fine), 25000 Hz (balanced), 100000 Hz (fast)
Tip: a smaller interval finds signals more easily (limited by the radio bandwidth)
scanner.扫描期间检测信号的速率\n\n基于 FFT 分析的内存信号检测速率。\n由于大部:
Rate at which signals are checked while scanning

In-memory signal detection rate based on FFT analysis.
Most of the work is digital spectrum analysis rather than
physical hardware tuner steps, so very high rates are possible.

Common values:
10 Hz = conservative, very stable
25 Hz = balanced (recommended starting point)
50 Hz = fast scan
100-500 Hz = very fast scan

Higher rates use more CPU but find signals sooner
scanner.启用最高 %d Hz 的扫描速率 (默认上限为 %d Hz)\n\n基于 FFT:
Enables scan rates up to %d Hz (the default limit is %d Hz)

FFT-based scanning (Frequency Manager mode) can sustain higher rates
because most of the work is in-memory spectrum analysis.

Warning: very high scan rates (>500 Hz) can use a lot of CPU
and may slow down system responsiveness
scanner.信号检测带宽占 VFO 宽度的百分比\n提示: 从 100%% 开始可获得最佳检:
Signal detection bandwidth as a percentage of the VFO width

- scan rate %dHz: about %dms tuning wait

scanner.黑名单条目的频率匹配容差 (Hz)\n该范围内的两个频率视为同一频率\n提示::

Two frequencies within this range are treated as the same
Tip: small values (100-500 Hz) give precise control
Larger values (1-5 kHz) tolerate frequency drift
Default: 1000 Hz, range: 100 Hz - 100 kHz
scanner.覆盖率说明:\n100%% = 最全面 (间隔 <=2.5 kHz)，不漏任何信:
Coverage explained:
100%% = most thorough (interval <=2.5 kHz), misses no signal
98%%+ = excellent (interval <=5 kHz), finds weak signals
85%%+ = good (interval 10 kHz), balances speed and thoroughness
70%%+ = fair (interval 20 kHz), may miss some weak signals
50%%+ = fast (interval 40+ kHz), only suitable for strong signals

Higher coverage scans more thoroughly but slower
Lower coverage scans faster but may miss weak signals
scanner.检测到间隙: 部分频率可能被遗漏。\n\n含义:\n- 分析间隔相对于信号检测需:
Gaps detected: some frequencies may be missed.

Meaning:
- The analysis interval is too large for the required signal detection
- Weak or intermittent transmissions may be missed
- Active frequencies between scan points may be skipped

Fixes:
- Reduce the analysis interval to improve coverage
- Decide whether the current speed/coverage trade-off is acceptable
scanner.检测到重叠: 同一频率被多次扫描。\n\n含义:\n- 间隔很小，精度很高\n-:
Overlap detected: the same frequencies are scanned several times.

Meaning:
- The interval is very small, giving very high precision
- The same frequency range is scanned multiple times

Benefits:
- Captures the weakest signals
- High chance of catching intermittent transmissions

Cost:
- Slower overall scan speed
- May dwell too long in one area, covering less spectrum
scanner.分析间隔 = 内存中频率分析的步长 (%.1f kHz)\n\n实时 FFT 分:
Analysis interval = step of the in-memory frequency analysis (%.1f kHz)

Real-time FFT analysis:
- FFT size: %d points
- Sample rate: %.1f MHz
- FFT resolution: %.1f Hz per bin
- VFO bandwidth: %.1f kHz

How it works:
1. The radio hardware hops between the main frequency points within your band
2. At each stop, the in-memory frequency analysis checks the spectrum in %.1f kHz steps
   (no hardware tuner steps needed, so it is very fast!)

Analysis interval guide:
- 2.5-5 kHz: highest sensitivity, catches the weakest signals
- 6.25-12.5 kHz: balanced choice for most uses
- 25 kHz: fast scan, only suitable for strong signals
- 50+ kHz: extremely fast, only for nearby/high-power transmissions

Choose the interval according to the target signals and the band
scanner.分析间隔 = 频率步长 (%.1f kHz)\n\n当前系统:\n- FFT 大:
Analysis interval = frequency step (%.1f kHz)

Current system:
- FFT size: %d points
- Sample rate: %.1f MHz
- FFT resolution: %.1f Hz per bin

Note: Frequency Manager mode is recommended for the best performance.
Enable scanning for frequency entries in the Frequency Manager
to use FFT-based signal detection for faster, more efficient scanning.
scanner.频率管理器 + FFT 模式\n\n优化的两级扫描:\n- 大步进的频段由频率管:
Frequency Manager + FFT mode

Optimized two-level scanning:
- Large-step bands are defined by the Frequency Manager (fast hardware hops)
- Small-interval in-memory frequency analysis (current: %.1f kHz)
- Result: the hardware makes large hops between the main frequencies
  and at each stop the FFT analyzes the spectrum digitally in small steps

Why it is efficient:
- Hardware tuning is slow (milliseconds per step)
- FFT analysis is fast (microseconds per frequency)
- Combines the speed of large steps with the thoroughness of small intervals

Ideal for covering wide frequency ranges quickly and thoroughly
scanner.基础扫描模式\n\n建议:\n请在频率管理器中为频率条目启用扫描，\n以使用优化:
Basic scan mode

Recommendation:
Enable scanning for frequency entries in the Frequency Manager
to use optimized two-level scanning and FFT-based signal detection.

This keeps the same thoroughness and signal detection ability
while scanning much faster.
scanner.覆盖优化建议\n\n这些建议基于对当前扫描配置的实时分析，包括:\n- SDR:
Coverage optimization tips

These suggestions are based on a real-time analysis of the current scan configuration, including:
- The actual FFT size and sample rate of the SDR
- The actual VFO bandwidth from the radio settings
- The current Frequency Manager entries and profiles
- The calculated gaps, overlap and coverage

Following them gives the best balance between speed and signal detection.
